Junior Backend Engineer

About Us
We are a fast-growing fintech startup building payment infrastructure for small businesses.

Requirements
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field
- 1+ years of experience with Python or Java
- Familiarity with SQL and relational databases
- Must have strong communication skills

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience with Docker and Kubernetes
- Familiarity with AWS
- Nice to have: exposure to FastAPI or Flask

Responsibilities
- Build and maintain backend services
- Write unit tests and participate in code reviews
- Collaborate with senior engineers on system design

Benefits
- Health insurance
- 401k matching
- Flexible work hours
